v7 IMPLEMENTATION SPEC (cycle-7 reviewer PASS)

11 files in one PR:

1. plugins/dso/scripts/compute-cross-branch-from-api.sh (NEW)
   - export LC_ALL=C at top
   - Header documents: subject format, custom-subject limitation, append contract, renamed-branch edge case, concurrent-sprint safety, top-level for-loop constraint
   - Env in: GITHUB_REPOSITORY, HEAD_REF, BASE_REF, ARTIFACT_DIR/CROSS_BRANCH_FILE
   - Defensive bootstrap: git rev-parse --verify origin/BASE_REF || git fetch || git fetch --unshallow || true
   - Derive epic-ids: mapfile -t epic_ids < <(git log origin/BASE..HEAD --grep '^Merge pull request' --format=%s | tr -d \\r | grep -oP 'story/\\K[^/]+' | LC_ALL=C sort -u)
   - Empty epic-ids: ::warning::no story merge commits; empty append; exit 0
   - Build epics_json via jq -R | jq -s
   - touch CROSS_BRANCH_FILE
   - Enumerate via gh api --paginate pulls?state=closed&base=HEAD_REF --jq with --argjson epics filter (merged_at + merge_commit_sha + head.ref regex + IN($epics[]))
   - Top-level for-loop main(): for each PR:
     * local retry_count=0; while true loop with single retry on 403/429 (Retry-After parse), hard fail on 5xx
     * git fetch origin merge_commit_sha --depth=1 || (warn + append PR files + continue)
     * git merge-base --is-ancestor merge_commit_sha HEAD || (warn + skip — rebase orphan)
     * git merge-base --is-ancestor merge_commit_sha origin/BASE_REF && (warn + skip — already on base)
     * gh api commits/SHA/check-runs --jq 'review-sub-pr conclusion' → success: subtract from re-review; else: append PR files to CROSS_BRANCH_FILE (re-include)
   - Failure modes: 404 = warn + re-include; 403/429 first attempt = sleep Retry-After + retry; 403/429 retry exhausted = ::error:: + exit 1; 500/502/503/504 = ::error:: + exit 1
   - Status parsing: gh api ... 2>&1 >out.tmp pattern with HTTP NNN substring case

2. .github/workflows/ci.yml (EDIT)
   - Add fetch-depth: 0 to llm-review job actions/checkout
   - Add new step (inside llm-review job, runs unconditionally alongside existing trailer-grep step) that calls compute-cross-branch-from-api.sh
   - Existing LC_ALL=C sort -u at line 555 dedups trailer-grep + API output (both write to cross-branch-files.txt)
   - Script exit 1 fails the workflow (no continue-on-error)

3. plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh (EDIT)
   - Read DSO_TRAILER_INJECTION_MODE at script start (default 'enabled'; 'disabled' = skip inject_trailer; 'dry-run' = log without amend)
   - Add inject_trailer(epic, story) function:
     * trap 'git worktree remove --force tmp_wt 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT INT TERM
     * git worktree add --quiet ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/dso-trailer-$$-story story/epic/story
     * commit_count = git rev-list --count origin/SESSION_BRANCH..HEAD
     * if 0: git commit --allow-empty -m '...' --trailer 'DSO-Story-Merge: story'
     * else: git commit --amend --no-edit --trailer 'DSO-Story-Merge: story'
     * git push --force-with-lease origin story_branch
     * Returns 0=ok, 1=worktree add fail, 2=commit fail, 3=push fail
   - Add inject_and_enable_automerge(pr_num, epic, story) function:
     * Check existing auto-merge state via gh pr view --json autoMergeRequest
     * Check existing trailer count via gh api .../commits | grep -c '^DSO-Story-Merge:'
     * 3-state case: enabled+0 = disable, inject, re-enable; enabled+>0 = noop (resume); none = inject, enable
   - Force-push protection probe at function entry: gh api repos/OWNER/REPO/branches/URL-ENCODED-BRANCH/protection; if allow_force_pushes.enabled == false: ::error:: + exit 1
   - Empty-amend-guard absorbed into inject_trailer's commit_count branch (always merges)
   - rc handling: 0 → proceed gh pr merge --auto; 1/2 → ::error:: + exit 1; 3 → ::warning:: + proceed (API fallback covers)
   - DSO_TRAILER_INJECTION_MODE=disabled: skip inject_trailer call; proceed with gh pr merge --auto; emit ::warning::
   - DSO_TRAILER_INJECTION_MODE=dry-run: log planned trailer; proceed with gh pr merge --auto
   - Document 'no retry after gh pr merge --auto enabled' rule in inline comment

4. plugins/dso/scripts/emit-story-merge-env.sh (NEW)
   - Self-check: [ \"\${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\" = \"\$0\" ] && exit 1 (must be sourced)
   - Look up parent epic via .claude/scripts/dso ticket show STORY_ID --format=llm | grep -oP '^parent:\\s*\\K\\S+'
   - export STORY_ID, STORY_EPIC_ID
   - return 1 if no parent epic resolvable

5. plugins/dso/skills/sprint/SKILL.md (EDIT)
   - Phase F Step 18 ci-pr branch: source emit-story-merge-env.sh STORY_ID before invoking merge-to-main.sh
   - Replace lines 2459-2463 false promise with: 'in ci-pr mode, merge-to-main-pr.sh injects the DSO-Story-Merge trailer onto the story branch via an ephemeral worktree before queueing gh pr merge --auto. ci.yml's compute-cross-branch-from-api.sh provides a GitHub API fallback for trailer-less merges (pre-Fix-D sessions or DSO_TRAILER_INJECTION_MODE=disabled). Per-PR review-sub-pr check-run conclusion is verified before subtracting files from INTEGRATION_SCOPE; non-success conclusions cause files to be re-included for full review at integration tier.'

6. tests/fixtures/ci-pr-auto-merge/ (NEW)
   - bin/gh — PATH-shadow stub dispatching on argv
   - DSO_GH_STUB_MODE env modes: unset=normal; error_403_secondary_limit; error_404_pr_5; error_500_first_call
   - pr-list.json, pr-files-N.json, check-runs-N.json fixtures
   - setup.sh creates synthetic repo with N 'Merge pull request' commits, no trailers

7. tests/scripts/test-compute-cross-branch-from-api.sh (NEW)
   - Assertions (a)-(s) including: empty/closed-not-merged filter, wrong-base exclusion, skipped-check-run re-inclusion, non-ancestor warning, gh-api-error exit-1, trailer+API dedup, multi-epic, shallow-clone, locale-pin (LC_ALL=fr), renamed-branch graceful, zero merge commits soft-exit

8. tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-trailer-injection.sh (NEW)
   - inject_trailer ephemeral-worktree success
   - inject_trailer empty-commit-count path uses --allow-empty
   - inject_trailer non-empty path uses --amend
   - inject_trailer rc=1/2/3 paths
   - trap cleanup on signal
   - 3-state idempotent auto-merge case discrimination
   - DSO_TRAILER_INJECTION_MODE=enabled/disabled/dry-run behavioral assertions

9. tests/scripts/test-emit-story-merge-env.sh (NEW)
   - sourced: exports STORY_ID + STORY_EPIC_ID on success
   - sourced no-parent: returns non-zero
   - executed-not-sourced: exits 1

10. .test-index (EDIT line 259 + ADD 2 lines)
    - Line 259: append ,tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr-trailer-injection.sh to existing comma list
    - Add: plugins/dso/scripts/compute-cross-branch-from-api.sh:tests/scripts/test-compute-cross-branch-from-api.sh
    - Add: plugins/dso/scripts/emit-story-merge-env.sh:tests/scripts/test-emit-story-merge-env.sh

11. plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (EDIT)
    - Add 'ci-pr Trailer Injection' section
    - Document DSO_TRAILER_INJECTION_MODE values: enabled (default), disabled (emergency rollback only — silent degradation), dry-run
    - Emergency-rollback language explicit
